data.title: Contribution notice for voluntary health insurance from 1 June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse sets your monthly contributions for voluntary membership from 1 June 2026 at €530.85 (health €412.65, long-term care €118.20). They are collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
data.explanation: This is a contribution decision (Beitragsbescheid) from your health insurer. Your total is €530.85 per month, collected automatically by direct debit on the 15th of the following month, so keep enough money in your account. If you think the amount is wrong, for example because of your income records, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the insurer. The app shows the deadline. If you don't object, the decision becomes final. Consider getting advice if unsure.

date.text: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
